subject: health
title: Launch and diagnostic: health determinants
essentialQuestion: How can understanding health systems, information, and self-advocacy help us explain, decide, create, or solve something that matters?
materials: unit-specific source, model, manipulatives, safe materials, or approved digital tool
keyPoints: Health determinants include biology, behavior, relationships, income, education, environment, discrimination, and access to care; they shape opportunity and risk without assigning blame.
A defensible community response uses accurate data, identifies the actor with authority, proposes a feasible change, protects privacy and access, and defines how progress will be measured.
For health determinants, a strong response distinguishes fact from assumption, uses a fictional or public case, and includes a safe next step or appropriate source of support.
privacySafeScenario: Create a reliable-information and self-advocacy toolkit using fictional scenarios.
studentTask: Draft a one-page fictional community response about health determinants: state the condition with two facts, identify who has authority to act, propose one feasible change, name a privacy or access safeguard, and define one measure that would show progress.
knowledgeCheck: In two or three sentences, explain the most important distinction in health determinants; use one lesson fact and name the evidence, safety check, or support route that makes the explanation dependable.
completionCriteria: The response completes every named part of the health determinants task using the supplied fictional or public case.
The response uses at least two accurate details from the lesson instruction and distinguishes evidence from assumption.
The response gives a safe, feasible next step or support route and does not depend on private disclosure, body comparison, or recorded media proof.
adaptationChoices: Provide readable text plus optional audio or read-aloud support; no voice feature is required. Chunk directions into one action at a time and show a worked example or model. extensionChallenge: Apply health determinants under a new constraint, compare two approaches or perspectives, or teach the idea with an original example without completing another learner’s graded work.
